changes_required.observed: CONDITIONS and FORM_SHA256 identify run 001; runtime verification pins source bytes.
changes_required.required: In a new source directory bind the adopted run-002 form, admissions and trial-plan hashes. Reject all unadopted candidates; no replacement of old pins in place.

changes_required.observed: Seven generation trial IDs and a single reservation type are hardcoded.
changes_required.required: Keep the seven generation IDs/order, plus C-<trial> count slots. Enforce one count per trial, separate caps seven/seven and total fourteen if adopted. Consume reserved attempt slots on uncertain delivery/errors; prohibit bypassing the paired-count dependency. Account for both kinds under one USD 1 budget.

changes_required.observed: Checks a claimed origin string, request/model/count range and nonempty method hash, but does not verify count exchange provenance and linked receipt files.
changes_required.required: Validate the adopted method hash, exact payload projection, raw count exchange and receipt hashes, run/trial/case/version/state/view linkage, and host transport origin before issuing a bound for immutable generation bytes. A supplied JSON origin label is insufficient.

changes_required.observed: The old reader loads a precomputed bound file before the pipeline builds the request.
changes_required.required: In one fresh process read the authoritative store, build/fix bytes, count, validate the receipt, then generate from exactly those bytes. Store metadata provides host configuration, not prior memory. Handoff remains case ID and store path; writer exit precedes reader start. No comparison-store inputs.

changes_required.observed: Case IDs appear in state/action/input values and therefore affect canonical hashes.
changes_required.required: Keep prompt tasks, schemas and settings as scientifically specified. Rebuild initial state/action/view bytes and R4 fixture bytes against the new case IDs and legitimate initial hashes before execution. Do not string-replace old hashes or copy received fixture requests as live inputs.

changes_required.observed: Candidate guard, admission checks and task-vs-legality scoring are separate from call accounting.
changes_required.required: Keep the minimal guard byte-identical and one checked commit path. Retain D15 legality/task separation, paired raw proposal replay and R4 categories. Scope remains synthetic evidence and state preservation; no security/adoption claims.

changes_required.observed: Old manifests and 69/68/003 results identify earlier code and data.
changes_required.required: Hash all new runtime files, templates, inputs and R4 bytes in new manifests. Use the specified validator for relevant new data and record checks of changed transport/accounting logic separately; do not relabel old results.

receipt_authority_limits: Use a host-owned transport result tied to the current attempt; fixture/manual records never acquire live authority from matching JSON. Hashes establish byte linkage, not general authenticity or privileged-write resistance. The count response does not itself report the model ID.
focused_checks_planned_not_executed: Unknown count price, unadopted form or missing active method blocks before network dispatch.
Mutated count/generation bytes, method hash, receipt hash, run/trial/case/version/view linkage or fixture origin blocks bound issuance.
Counts 8192 and 8193, malformed/duplicate-key JSON, booleans and transport errors exercise the defined boundary without live calls.
Duplicate count for a trial, eighth count/generation, aggregate overflow, wrong ordering and budget overflow are blocked; failures retain slots and reservations.
A fresh reader counts its actual immutable saved-state request and uses those same bytes for mock dispatch; summaries and comparison stores cannot replace authoritative reads.
Run-specific initial/R4 hashes and exact-validator checks cover newly bound data; prior results are only historical references.

storage_plan.policy: Separate output ID, outside the source kit. Resolve and create exclusively only in a future authorized start; no old output reuse or deletion.

environment_plan: The received Windows venv is a candidate for later checks. Its historical success does not establish these unimplemented changes.
